:::{#thm-entropy-scaling}
#### Rescaling changes entropy by the log of the scale

Let $X$ be a [continuous random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-continuous-rv) with [entropy](#def-entropy) $\entropyf{X}$,
and let $a \ne 0$ be a [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers).
Then

$$\entropyf{aX} = \entropyf{X} + \log \abs{a}.$$

[@cover2006elements, Theorem 8.6.4]

:::

::: proof

Let $Y \eqdef aX$.
The [density](random-variables.qmd#def-pdf) of $Y$ is

$$\p(Y=y) = \frac{1}{\abs{a}} \pf{X = \frac{y}{a}}.$$

At the value $y = ax$, the density of $Y$ is therefore $1/\abs{a}$ times the density of $X$ at $x$.
Taking $-\log$ of both sides turns this relation into one between [surprisals](#def-surprisal):

$$\surprisalf{aX} = \surprisalf{X} + \log \abs{a}.$$

Hence

$$
\ba
\entropyf{aX}
&= \E{\surprisalf{aX}} && \text{(definition of entropy)} \\
&= \E{\surprisalf{X} + \log \abs{a}} && \text{(surprisal of } aX \text{)} \\
&= \E{\surprisalf{X}} + \log \abs{a} && \text{(linearity of expectation)} \\
&= \entropyf{X} + \log \abs{a}. && \text{(definition of entropy)}
\ea
$$

:::
